entities.summary: Horacio Zeballos Jr. is an Argentine professional tennis player. He reached a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 1 on 6 May 2024, becoming the first Argentinian man to achieve the feat. He is a Grand Slam champion at the 2025 French Open and at the 2025 US Open with Marcel Granollers.
